svg.title: Scenario 7: Enemy Turn — Goblin Still Stunned, StunEffect Expires

g.text: Scenario 7: Enemy Turn — Goblin Still Stunned, StunEffect Expires
This is the enemy phase of the same executePlayerTurn() call as Scenario 6.
Goblin's StunEffect has remainingTurns=1 entering this turn.
Goblin skips again, and this time the StunEffect expires and is removed.
Same user action that triggered Scenario 6.
Shown here for continuity — enemy phase
occurs in the same executePlayerTurn() call.
Warrior phase: Potion used, healed 100 HP.
StunEffect.onExpire() is a no-op by default.
No attack TurnFrame added for Goblin.
Goblin will attack normally next round.
GameState.newTurnOrder() — Goblin has NO StunEffect now
(Goblin did not attack — Stun icon gone next round)
